title: FLA import: symbol registration point skipped — CPicObjBase tx/ty skipped with r.skip(8)
description: In flash8-binary.ts around line 973, the CPicObjBase record contains two s32 registration point fields that are unconditionally skipped with r.skip(8). These represent the symbol's registration point (origin offset). Fix: decode both s32 values as registrationX and registrationY, add them to Fla8Instance, forward in flash8-import.ts convertElement(), and add registrationPoint?: {x:number, y:number} to SymbolInstance in engine/types.ts. In compile.ts, use the registration point to offset the PlaceObject matrix when placing instances — the registration point shifts the symbol's local origin.
